verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so automated dependency and code security scanning is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no built-in vulnerability, dependency or code scanning feature. Showing external CI results (Buildkite builds, GitHub Actions checks) and requiring passing checks via rulesets are adjacent features that a user could wire scanners into, not the product's own scanning, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have my repository automatically scanned for vulnerable dependencies and code security issues
